exclusions.label: Wazir’s mechanical flying fish
exclusions.reason: Routine homunculus creation, scouting, and attacks. No independent continuing personality or relationship establishes a companion identity; mechanical naming in the character interface does not change that.

exclusions.label: Other water creatures and their expedition
exclusions.reason: Interchangeable elemental minions, including bulk speakers and tactical leaders, without individual identities. Their temporary retrieval mission does not establish an organization; the marid and borderline altar tester are tracked separately.

exclusions.label: Routine PC magic equipment and tattoos
exclusions.reason: Ordinary activation or use of existing equipment: Cloak of the Manta Ray, Mariner armor, secret-door wand, warning sword, weapons and magical tattoos. No qualifying acquisition or new original item lore occurs.

exclusions.label: Glowing altar, statue and magical shrine doorway
exclusions.reason: Fixed features of the shrine rather than independently identified portable items or characters. Their protective magic and prayer mechanism remain context for Guzo and the recovered crystal.

exclusions.label: Miscellaneous offerings, jewelry and stone chest
exclusions.reason: Generic loot and a storage container, without independently meaningful object identities. The three recovered texts are individually distinguished.

exclusions.label: Ryu’s boat, coastline sketch, and improvised debris weapons
exclusions.reason: Ordinary transport, navigation aid and improvised equipment. Their practical use does not establish distinct object identities beyond this expedition.

exclusions.label: Unnamed captain thrown out of the Leviathan
exclusions.reason: A brief rumor-spreading visitor defined only by one past incident, without a name, continuing identity, or specific mystery attached to the person.

exclusions.label: Rayna’s parents and lost ship crew
exclusions.reason: Unclear, incidental secondhand family and casualty references. Caleb has a name and meaningful personal history and is included separately.

exclusions.label: Hypothetical painter, caving friends, and messenger
exclusions.reason: Generic contacts or proposed helpers without established individual identities or meaningful independent involvement; Trok ultimately draws the image himself.

exclusions.label: Mos Numena and St. Guzo’s church as organizations
exclusions.reason: The source describes a religious tradition and a local place of worship, without identifying a separate persistent institution to map. Its named divine beings and priest are retained.

exclusions.label: Wizards of the Academy as a separate organization
exclusions.reason: Broad academic and magical establishment in a rumor, not one clearly bounded organization. The explicitly mentioned university is retained without conflating it with the independent Great Library or other societies.

exclusions.label: Magistrates and the column of war wizards
exclusions.reason: Generic officeholders and a marching force in distant news, without enough identity detail to resolve a particular individual or persistent formation.

exclusions.label: Riswynn, Lakan Monastery and other table framing
exclusions.reason: Early time-skip comparisons and hypothetical character abilities do not themselves establish meaningful involvement here. Later in-world rumors are assessed separately for the people they actually identify.

exclusions.label: Hamri, Omi, and generic merfolk rebuilding
exclusions.reason: Places and populations, not separately established organizations or individually identifiable people. The shared vision does not give its anonymous inhabitants distinct identities.

exclusions.label: Wazir’s staff named Claude
exclusions.reason: A table joke about contemporary AI, not established fictional identities of the inn staff.
